items.summary: One of the biggest roadblocks to starting up a data center is getting approval to connect to the electric grid—a wait that could last as long as a decade. Some developers aren’t willing to wait and are instead opting to build their own off-grid, or behind-the-meter, gas power plants to fuel the AI boom. xAI’s Memphis campus has famously used dozens of natural gas turbines, some of them without permits, as far back as 2024.
